messages.content:
Can you search the electronics catalog for headphones and reserve 1 Sony XM5 Black (product ID p_sony_xm5_blk) for me, user_01? Once that's done, please build my cart with this item, check my available coupons, and apply the best discount, which is SAVE15. Next, generate a stripe payment invoice for alice@company.com. 

Afterward, please check the calendar availability for alice (user ID u_alice) starting on 2024-11-01. Then, scan for smart devices in the living_room, select the smart lock (lock_main) from the results, and lock it. Finally, send an email alert to Alice with the generated invoice message, and create a document titled "Transaction and Security Log" to record the notification status.
